note: Edit this file to change quests. 'code' quests unlock with a code word given in person; the file holds only its SHA-256 hash of the uppercase word. 'auto' quests complete themselves when the named localStorage key exists.

groups.title: Day one
groups.blurb: Do these first. They take one morning.

groups.title: Any week
groups.blurb: Pick them off whenever. Most are better with a group from the chat.

groups.title: The big days
groups.blurb: The three dated events. Codes are given at the door.

quests.title: Register at Mirai Base
steps: Go to the Medtech Innovation Center on Port Island. That is Mirai Base.
Find the registration desk. It is in the same room as breakfast.
Ask the team for the day-one code word and enter it here.

quests.title: Put your name on the map
steps: Open the map.
Type your name under "Your name".
Press "Share my location" and allow it. Your pin appears where you stand.

quests.title: Have breakfast at Mirai Base
steps: Breakfast is served every morning at the Medtech Innovation Center.
Sit with someone you have not met.

quests.title: Find your cowork desk
steps: Go to the Shimin Byoin Mae Building, 4th floor.
Pick a desk. The space is open all month.

quests.title: Get an IC card for the Port Liner
steps: Buy an ICOCA card at a JR ticket machine in Sannomiya station.
Top it up at any machine. It works on the Port Liner, trains, buses, and in convenience stores.
Tap in and out at the gates.

quests.title: Join the city chat
steps: Open the chat link and introduce yourself: name, track, what you are building.
Dinner groups form in the chat by six every evening.

quests.title: Come to opening night
steps: Opening night is at the Medtech Innovation Center on the evening of October 4.
Bring the people from your house.

quests.title: Take a lab tour
steps: Lab tours run through KBIC on Port Island and out to Kyoto and Osaka between October 5 and 16.
Sign up for one in the chat when the list is posted.

quests.title: Show up for the hackathon kickoff
steps: The Longevity × Bio Hackathon with Nucleate Japan starts on October 9.
Form a team or join one. Teams pitch investors at Demo Day.

quests.title: Go to the Saturday farmers market
steps: The farmers market is in central Kobe on Saturday mornings.
Buy breakfast there instead of at Mirai Base.

quests.title: Go to an onsen
steps: Arima Onsen is the famous one near Kobe.
Go with a group from the chat. Tattoos: check the rules of the bath first.

quests.title: Climb Mount Rokko
steps: The trailheads are on the north side of the city.
Go early. Some residents run it before breakfast.

quests.title: Have lunch with someone from another track
steps: Devices, therapies, or builders: find someone working on the other thing.
A set lunch in Kobe is under ¥1,000.

quests.title: Attend Summit I
steps: Summit I is at the Integrated Research Center, Convention Hall, on October 17 and 18.
Get the code word at the door.

quests.title: Attend Summit II
steps: Day 1 is at the Integrated Research Center on October 24.
Day 2 is at the Kobe Portopia Hotel on October 25.
Get the code word at the door.

quests.title: Be at the Fashion Show and Demo Day
steps: Orbis Hall is on the 5th floor of the Kobe Fashion Museum on Rokko Island.
Doors are on October 26 from 3 to 6 PM.
Get the code word at the door.
